To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to formally appeal the denial of prior authorization for [requestedMed] for my patient, {{patient_name}} (DOB: {{patient_dob}}, Member ID: {{member_id}}), dated [denialDate].

CLINICAL SUMMARY

This patient carries a confirmed diagnosis of Chronic Insomnia Disorder (ICD-10: G47.09) meeting ICSD-3 criteria:
• Frequency: ≥3 nights per week
• Daytime impairment: documented (fatigue, cognitive dysfunction, occupational/social impairment)

PRIOR TREATMENT HISTORY

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) was attempted. See documentation.


EVIDENCE BASE FOR REQUESTED TREATMENT

The requested medication, [requestedMed], carries a Strong recommendation in the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults (Sateia MJ, et al., J Clin Sleep Med. 2017;13(2):307–349). The AASM April 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline on combination CBT-I and pharmacotherapy further supports the use of pharmacologic agents in patients with partial or inadequate CBT-I response.

BASIS FOR APPEAL

Chronic insomnia disorder is a recognized medical condition (ICD-10 G47.09) with significant morbidity. Untreated chronic insomnia is associated with a 2-fold increased risk of major depression (Baglioni C, et al., J Affect Disord. 2011), increased cardiovascular risk, impaired immune function, and a 2–3 fold increased risk of motor vehicle accidents. The requested treatment is medically necessary and consistent with AASM guidelines.


REQUESTED ACTION

I respectfully request immediate approval of [requestedMed] for this patient. I am available for a peer-to-peer review with the medical director at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,

[Physician Name, MD/DO]
[Specialty: Sleep Medicine / Psychiatry]
{{practice_name}}
{{practice_phone}} | {{practice_fax}}
{{npi}}

References:
1. Sateia MJ, et al. AASM CPG Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia. J Clin Sleep Med. 2017;13(2):307–349.
2. Edinger JD, et al. AASM CPG Behavioral/Psychological Treatments for Chronic Insomnia. J Clin Sleep Med. 2021;17(2):255–262.
3. AASM April 2026 CPG: Combination CBT-I + Pharmacotherapy. J Clin Sleep Med. 2026.
4. Baglioni C, et al. Insomnia as a predictor of depression. J Affect Disord. 2011;135(1–3):10–19.
5. AASM Practice Guidelines: https://aasm.org/clinical-resources/practice-standards/practice-guidelines/
